{{nihongo|'''Hime Shrine (Nanto City)'''|比賣神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Etchū Province]].

'''Hime Shrine''' (ひめじんじゃ, also read ひめのじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Takamiya, {{ill|Nanto, Toyama|Q646805|qid=Q646805}}, {{ill|Toyama Prefecture|Q132929|qid=Q132929}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, one of the seven Tonami shrines in {{ill|Etchū Province|Q906899|qid=Q906899}}.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined in the southwestern part of {{ill|Toyama Prefecture|Q132929|qid=Q132929}}, south of {{ill|Nanto, Toyama|Q646805|qid=Q646805}}.

Under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|Q742460|qid=Q742460}}, it was one of the Tonami seven shrines of {{ill|Etchū Province|Q906899|qid=Q906899}}. The other shrines are {{ill|Takase Shrine (Nanto)|Q3791906|qid=Q3791906}}, {{ill|Hayashi Shrine|Q11533248|qid=Q11533248}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nagaoka Shrine}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Aranami Shrine}}, and {{ill|Ogami Shrine (disambiguation)|Q11659236|qid=Q11659236}}.

During the {{ill|Sengoku period|Q204023|qid=Q204023|lt=Sengoku period}}, it fell into ruin in warfare during Uesugi Kenshin's Etchū campaign, but local notables lamented the loss of the historic site, collected materials, and rebuilt it.
